name: MusaCAD unified CAD core gate-coverage index
scope: Versioned functional acceptance gate coverage, not work-hours, feature quality, AutoCAD 2026 equivalence, or certified release readiness
method: Fixed 25 equal, binary gates; ONLY 'accepted' items count; a candidate counts only after required CI and source review. 4% per accepted gate. Do not credit synthetic field tests as real drawing acceptance.
run_policy: On each change: keep a separate CI pass ratio; update accepted only with exact source and successful tests. Never alter denominator silently.
